description: A React component named RemindersSend that provides a user interface for sending reminders (via WhatsApp or Email) to a list of customers. The component allows selecting multiple customers through checkboxes and triggers a callback to send reminders.

methods.name: RemindersSend({ customers = [], onSendReminders })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a list of customers with checkboxes to select recipients and a button to send reminders.

methods.name: toggleChecked
methods.description: Function to toggle the selection state of a customer in the list.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Function to invoke the callback onSendReminders with the list of selected customer IDs.
